caption: Figure 1-1. Structure of the project report.
Figure 3-1. Source fitting, external evaluation and controlled adaptive replay.

Figure 4-1. Source-test precision–recall curves for seed 17. Panel (a) shows the full range and class-prevalence baseline; panel (b) expands the high-score region. Dots mark validation-selected thresholds. Both panels use the same observed predictions.

Figure 4-2. External-holdout precision–recall curves for the frozen seed-17 forests. Threshold dots retain source-validation choices. The external prevalence differs from the source-test prevalence, so AP values must be interpreted within their respective populations.
Figure 4-3. Mean absolute phishing-score SHAP contributions on 160 source-test observations, using 80 source-training background examples.
Figure 4-4. Exploratory source-holdout F1 under restricted feature sets. These diagnostic variants reuse the source holdout and do not constitute independent confirmatory experiments.

Figure 4-5. Source-switch batch F1 aligned to each realization’s designed boundary. Lines are three-run means and shading is one standard deviation, not a confidence interval. Only relative positions observed in all three realizations are shown.

Figure 4-6. Source-switch forest refits and total forest fitting time, averaged over three runs. The threshold-only policy changes cutoffs without refitting. Fitting time excludes detection, calibration, prediction and checkpoint persistence.
